Second-level read: this is not a demand-thesis change (Vera Rubin production, CUDA lock-in, $145B supply commitments all stand) but IS a real new counterparty/contingent-liability risk category that didn't exist before 07-27 — priced in via a -5.7% underperformance vs. the broader semiconductor sector's +10-17% rally on 07-30 (MSFT/Samsung earnings eased AI-capex-cut fears). Widening MoS to 33.2% reflects the market extracting a real risk premium, not an emerging discount to an unchanged thesis. **2026-08-04 update:** price recovered +3.1% on 08-03 (sentiment reversal, no new fundamental — WebSearch confirms next earnings not until Aug 26) with no change to the circular-financing overhang (still talks-stage, same $250B/$350B figures being recirculated in 08-03 headline). story_gate.what: ASML is the sole global producer of EUV lithography systems—the only machines capable of patterning leading-edge transistors—beating competitors via a multi-decade ecosystem moat (Zeiss optics, TRUMPF light sources) that cannot be replicated.
story_gate.why: Consensus saw Q2 as "beat but priced-in" going in — Warren sees the actual result as a genuine second-level surprise: ASML raised FY2026 guidance for the **second time this year** (€36-40B→€43-45B) with margin guide also up (51-53%→54-56%), and Q3 guide (€11-12B) implies a sharp H2 acceleration — this is not backlog chatter anymore, it's a confirmed structural re-rating of the AI-driven demand curve that the market is still catching up to (sell-side PTs jumping to $2,200-2,623 same-day). The unresolved China/export-control overhang (07-14 law + 07-28/07-29 China domestic-DUV progress) remains the genuine counter-risk — but that risk sits on the DUV/mature-node revenue line (~19-20% of 2026 rev), not on the EUV leading-edge monopoly the thesis is built on; today's own follow-up (07-29) assesses the near-term severity as low. A 4-day sector-wide semi selloff (SMH -12% from peak, not ASML-specific) has pushed the price well below where Q2's beat-and-raise alone would put it, widening the entry margin further. **2026-08-04 update:** the 08-04 🔴MATERIAL headline ("ASML influence declining as competing tech absorbs share") WebSearched in full — it is the same China-domestic-DUV narrative continuing, and independent coverage (Morningstar-cited moat analysis, 08-04) confirms ASML still holds >80% of total lithography revenue and 100% of EUV; the China threat is framed as a 2-3 year gradual DUV/low-end substitution (~20 units vs. an order book measured in hundreds), "real in the long run but overstated for 2026-2027." Same-day 08-03 news (Bernstein "Top Q3 Pick," Goldman added to European Conviction List, backlog "still strong despite chip-market pressure") is a genuine positive counterweight not yet reflected on this card. No new information that changes the EUV monopoly thesis.
story_gate.risk: A major customer (TSMC or Samsung) delays leading-edge node ramp by 12+ months, or US/EU export restrictions expand to broader DUV categories (MATCH Act risks cutting ~19-20% of revenue from China) — **or** China's domestic DUV tooling (07-28/07-29 news) scales fast enough to materially displace ASML DUV unit sales into China (watch for shipment/share data, not just "started production" headlines) — breaking the order book; or H2 2026 execution falls short of the newly-raised guide.

Q3 guide $13.0B±$300M (+41% YoY) แข็งแรง. **แต่ตลาดตอบสนองแบบ "sell the news"**: หุ้นวิ่งขึ้น +7% ระหว่างวัน 08-04 ปิดที่ $518.58 (ราคาที่ปรากฏใน prices_cache.json รอบนี้ — **แต่เป็นราคาปิดตลาดปกติก่อนงบออกหลังตลาดปิด ไม่ใช่ราคาล่าสุด**), แล้วร่วง after-hours -8.8% เหลือ **~$472.94** และ pre-market ต่อเนื่องแถว **$474-475** เช้า 08-05 (ยืนยันจาก yfinance fast_info previousClose $472.85 + WebSearch หลายแหล่ง — finbold/tradingkey) — expectations ที่ baked-in ไปแล้ว (avg analyst PT ~$582 ก่อนงบ) สูงกว่าที่ผลจริงจะ satisfy ได้ แม้ผลจะ beat ตัวเลขที่ประกาศไว้ก็ตาม. Second-level read: TAM raise เป็นของจริง (management เอง ไม่ใช่แค่ analyst) แต่ตลาดกำลัง price-in ว่า "ดีมากแล้ว ดีกว่านี้ยาก" ระยะสั้น — MoS ยังคง fail gate ต่อเนื่อง แม้ที่ราคาที่ถูกกว่าที่ cache แสดง
story_gate.risk: MI450 ramp slip หรือ ROCm ตาม CUDA ไม่ทัน ทำให้ hyperscalers ไม่ adopt จริงจัง — หรือ ถ้า "agentic CPU" consensus narrative พิสูจน์ว่า overhype (TAM ไม่ materialize ตามที่ BofA/management project) ราคาจะ de-rate เร็ว — เพิ่มเติมรอบนี้: forward commitments ($30.3B unconditional + subsequent $5.0B investment + $9.5B new DC leases) พุ่งเร็วกว่ารายได้ ถ้า AI demand ชะลอกว่าที่ผูกพันไว้ = balance-sheet stress risk ใหม่

SKHY.name: SK hynix Inc. ADR
SKHY.idea: 08-06 news: SK hynix launched 375-layer NAND with 2.5x power efficiency — a genuine new product data point (not re-syndication), but NAND is only ~22% of revenue mix and there's no quantified revenue/margin figure yet to feed the normalized mid-cycle earnings estimate. BQ/GP held unchanged pending Q3 numbers. Price pulled back -7.44% on sector-wide sentiment, narrowing the MoS fail from -35.5% to -25.37% (still a clear fail — cyclical discipline unchanged, this is a price move toward FV, not new de-cycling evidence).
risk: If de-cycling proves real (LTA floors hold + margin >50% sustained across a down-cycle) normalized earnings could be too low; downside if Samsung/CXMT HBM parity compresses margin as forecast, or if the DRAM ASP mix-timing miss (Daiwa flag) becomes a real demand issue in Q3 rather than timing.
bull: HBM leadership + AI memory demand จริง structural — Q2 actuals add the first concrete (not just narrative) de-cycling evidence (LTAs, ~10 customers) + margin still rising (71%→76%), but net profit headline (118% margin) remains distorted by a one-off Kioxia gain; normalized earnings still meaningfully below the Q2-annualized peak run-rate; Samsung/CXMT HBM parity risk + genuine cyclicality remain even as the "de-cycled" narrative gathers real (if early) evidence; 07-31 price rebound (sector sentiment) has moved SKHY further from, not closer to, a genuine entry point.

story_gate.what: SK hynix เป็นผู้นำ HBM อันดับ 1 โลก (56.4% share) ผลิต advanced memory (DRAM/HBM/NAND) ซึ่งเป็นหัวใจของ AI compute — ชนะด้วย HBM technology lead (HBM4 industry-first) + qualification switching cost + scale/vertical packaging.
story_gate.why: Q2 FY2026 actuals (first quarterly print since IPO, released 2026-07-29) landed: operating profit W60.54T at a **record 76% margin** (up from Q1's 71%) + concluded **LTAs with ~10 customers** — the first concrete contractual evidence for de-cycling, not just management rhetoric. Market reaction (07-29) framed this as "profit +557% YoY but below expectations" and the stock fell -15.0% to $131.41. Warren integrated the new data with a modest, evidence-linked upward revision to normalized mid-cycle earnings ($52B→$57B, same treatment as MU's SCA-confirmation adjustment) — **not** a re-rate to the peak run-rate, since SKHY still has zero down-cycle track record as a standalone public print. **2026-07-31 update:** 07-30/07-31 news confirmed (WebSearch) as re-syndication of the same 07-29 Q2 print — no new data. Price then **rebounded +13.4% to $149.00** on the broader 07-30 sector-wide semiconductor rally (not SKHY-specific), pushing MoS from -19.5% to a **deeper fail of -35.5%** — the rally moves SKHY further above normalized mid-cycle FV, the opposite direction of the AMD/LITE gate-narrowing effect from the same rally. Edge unchanged: don't chase a cyclical priced above normalized earnings; wait for the cycle to prove itself across a down-leg.
story_gate.risk: ถ้า de-cycling เป็นจริง — operating margin ยืน >50% ต่อเนื่อง 2+ ปีแม้ capacity ใหม่ (M15X/Yongin) ramp เต็ม + LTA floors ยืนไม่มี oversupply price crash — แปลว่า normalized earnings อยู่ใกล้ระดับ peak จริง, FV base ผิด, และราคาปัจจุบัน justified. Two consecutive quarters of rising (not falling) operating margin (71%→76%) is itself a data point in that direction — watch closely.

story_gate.why: Consensus is digesting a two-sided Q1 FY2027 print (clean beat on revenue/EPS but a royalty-growth guide cut on mobile BOM inflation, plus a crystallized Qualcomm/Nuvia court loss) alongside a genuine TAM reframe (AGI CPU Cloud AI CPU TAM $100B→$220B-equivalent, demand backlog >$2B) — Warren's edge is that even after reconciling the valuation to defensible (not just optimistic) consensus EPS, the stock trades at ~95x forward earnings on the re-derived base, i.e. the AGI CPU optionality is being priced as if it's already Base case when it still belongs in Bull; that gap is real but the market isn't pricing it as a gap.
